causebase_summary: Northern Rivers Animal Services (NRAS) is a self-funded, not-for-profit registered charity based in Ballina that rescues abandoned, abused, lost and unwanted dogs and cats across the Northern Rivers region of New South Wales. NRAS operates a rescue shelter at 61 Piper Drive, Ballina, places animals in foster care and runs monthly Adoption Days (first Saturday, 10:00–13:00) where prospective adopters can meet animals and access services such as microchipping, nail clipping and hydrobathing. Animals are desexed, microchipped, vaccinated and vet-checked prior to adoption. NRAS also runs a subsidised desexing program, operates an op shop in Ballina and stages community events (including Dogs Day Out and a pet calendar competition). Volunteer roles include foster caring, shelter and shop staffing, transport and general maintenance.

data.SummaryOfActivities: 1. We took in and provided a high level of care for 160 cats and 155 dogs during this reporting period.  These companion animals were either abandoned, lost, no longer wanted, unable to be cared for due to cost of living (and other mainly housing issues), unable to be housed in rental accommodation, owner unable to afford vet bills or surrendered to a local Council Pound. 2.  We provided a safe environment for these animals either at our Animal Shelter or in foster homes and provided food and veterinary care as needed, at our cost, until we found suitable permanent housing for them. 3.  We continued our program to help those experiencing financial hardship to assist with the desexing of their companion animals. 4.  We increased our local profile through engaging with residential care facilities, providing interaction with dogs in our care. 5.  We continued to make improvements to our animal shelter facilities to ensure the comfortable and safe accommodation of animals in our care. 6.  We supported our local community through engaging with and hosting the TAFE Animals Studies Department and continued a strong working relationship and spirit of cooperation with local Council Pounds.
